message.content:
Felt hats fall under heading 6505 (hats and other headgear, knitted or made up from lace, felt or other textile fabric in the piece). A seamless hat felted from loose fibers could instead be hat bodies, hoods, or plateaux of felt, not blocked or with brim, under 6501. A felted cone or hood without a brim would be classified in 6501. But a finished sauna hat is made up, so 6505 applies.

Within 6505, subheading 6505.00.15 covers "Hats and headgear of felt, made from hat bodies or hoods of 6501", and 6505.00.60 covers "Other: of wool felt..." The 6505.00 subheadings in the HTSUS are:
- 6505.00.80 – Other: Of cotton...
- 6505.00.15 – Fur felt or fur-blend felt hats... 
- 6505.00.20 – Hard hats
- 6505.00.30 – Hats and headgear of felt...?
- 6505.00.90 – Other: Of man-made fibers...

I recall: 6505.00.15 is "Hats and headgear, of fur felt," 6505.00.20 is "Hard hats," 6505.00.30 is "Hats and headgear, of felt, of wool, ... Other", and 6505.00.60 is "Other: of cotton," 6505.00.80 is "Of man-made fibers," and 6505.00.90 is "Other." This is a bit unclear, but a wool felt hat that is not made from a hat body likely falls under 6505.00.90 or the felt categories.

I believe the actual structure is: 6505.00.15 – Hats and headgear, of felt, of fur felt; 6505.00.20 – Hard hats; 6505.00.30 – Hats of wool felt (wool or fine animal hair), 6505.00.60 – Other: Of cotton, 6505.00.80 – Of man-made fibers, 6505.00.90 – Other. I'll go with 6505.00.30 for wool felt.
